Hide Absent Hide all wild animals not presently found on the map.

This does not alter any configurations, just what is shown in the manager. Hidden limits will act the same as before if new animals wander into the map. Hide Insects Hide all wild insects from the list. This is mainly useful if you don't want to hunt insect hives or have already set all insects to be hunted.

This does not alter any configurations, just what is shown in the manager. Hidden limits will act the same as before if new insects pop up and stick around long enough.
All Managed Not Managed This button can be used make the manager hide animals based on whether or not you have specified limits for the animal. Clicking the button cycles through All (no check made), Managed (at least one of the groups has a max listed, and Not Managed (all of the max columns for the animal are left on infinity).

This does not alter any configurations, just what is shown in the manager. Hidden limits will still be handled the same.
Non-pregnant animals will be chosen first from oldest to youngest, followed by pregnant animals from least to most progress through the pregnancy. Force Forces auto-hunt to always aim to hunt this animal down to the specified limits, regardless of current nutrition levels and target.

This may cause other auto hunted animals to be hunted less depending on food needed, but if the nutrition level is set high enough this setting does nothing. Hunt The animal to be automatically hunted. The current number of wild animals, both male and female.
